title: Improper preservation of consistency between independent representations of shared state in AMD Secure Encrypted…
description: A vulnerability in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization (SEV) firmware involves improper preservation of consistency between independent representations of shared state. This flaw could allow a malicious hypervisor to affect cache coherency for guest context pages, potentially leading to loss of integrity. The issue has a medium severity rating and no known exploits in the wild. No affected versions or patch information are provided.
